external_full_text_access_limits: Morina (2021) thesis PDF retrieval timed out; its criterion was cross-checked against the accessible 2026 paper's statement.

scientific_limitations: The boundary initial-form criterion is sufficient, not necessary.
The family is established for integer d >= 4; the proof does not cover d=3.
The general Bernoulli-factory existence step invokes Morina's published multivariate criterion; the thesis PDF was not directly read during this run.
The source paper contains the d=4 instance; the contribution is the general obstruction and all-degree family, with residual risk that this is viewed as a direct abstraction of its proof.
title: A boundary initial-form obstruction for finite-automata Bernoulli factories
